19.10.2023 Order No. Hybrid Mode 07. 1.

The BLAPL has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking release on bail, by the petitioners,
who are in jail custody in connection with Chandrasekharpur P.S. Case No.227 of 2023 corresponding to Special C.T. Case No.563 of 2023 pending in the court of learned JMFC-II,
Bhubaneswar, for alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/34 of IPC.
2.

Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners refers to the affidavit dated 19.10.2023 filed today and submits that the father of the petitioners has been advised to file this affidavit to seek indulgence from this Court.
The affidavit be taken on record.
The case brief as well as the scanned copy be updated.

It is submitted by the learned Senior Counsel that in terms of the parapgraph-5 of the affidavit,
the petitioners have been advised to security deposit of Rs.6,00,000/- (Rupees Six Lakhs) only before the learned court in seision of the matter and property security of the rest of the amount as Dipti Ranjan Jena And vs State Of Odisha .... 1 alleged, i.e. about Rs.10,00,000/-, which shall be furnished to the satisfaction of the learned court in seisin of the matter as a pre-condition for grant of bail.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the petitioners are the local residents having roots in the society and there is no possibility of they evading the jurisdiction of the learned court in seisin of the matter.
4. Learned Standing Counsel for the State referring to the contents of the case diary and the allegations against the petitioner opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioners.
5. Learned counsel for the informant also vehemently opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioners referring to the allegation.
However, it is not disputed at the bar that the Final Police Report has been submitted on 07.07.2023.

5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned Standing Counsel for the State and the learned counsel for the informant, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioners subject to such stringent terms and conditions that would be imposed by the learned court in seisin of the matter along with the condition as stated in the affidavit dated 19.10.2023 filed on behalf of the father of the petitioners that an amount of Rs.6,00,000/-(Rupees Six // 3 // Lakhs) shall be deposited and the rest amount of Rs.10,00,000/- shall be secured by property security, without prejudice to the rights and contentions of the petitioners before the learned court in seisin of the matter.

The condition for grant of bail shall also include a further condition that in case of violation of deviation from any of the terms and conditions that would be imposed, shall result in filing of the petition for cancellation of bail by the informant/victim/law enforcement agency.
6. The learned court in seisin of the matter shall have the liberty to keep the amount deposited, in an interest bearing fixed deposit with auto renewal clause, in any nationalized bank.
7. The BLAPL is disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.

(M.S. Sahoo)
